thread:
Jared Kim: Heads-up - OrchidLabs renewal stalled. Procurement says they need a FedRAMP-lite attestation and a new billing entity on the contract. They want PO + W-9 for the new entity. Renewal date 2024-06-01.

Maya Chen: Vendor change ok but revops needs legal name + tax ID and an executed amendment before we can invoice. Net30 is standard; customer asked for net45. Any business reason to agree?

Lina Morales: Customer says EU subsidiary will pay for support & services, US entity for seats. They asked to split invoice 70/30. Can we handle split billing? @Ravi (Finance)

Ravi (Finance): We can do split invoicing if both entities have vendor records and PO numbers. We'll need separate POs and corresponding billing contacts. Also need the W-9 for the US entity and VAT lookup for EU. Net45 acceptable only if sales credit holds and we add a 1.5% processing fee.

Anjali (Security): FedRAMP-lite request - we don't have FedRAMP attestation. We can provide our SOC2 report and a security questionnaire response. Offer a security addendum and an action plan for any open items. That should satisfy most procurement teams short-term.

Jared Kim: Customer insists on FedRAMP mention in contract. Legal told me earlier that adding FedRAMP claim is a no-go. Suggest offering an addendum: "Customer acknowledges Redwood provides SOC2 Type II report; FedRAMP compliance is not represented." Thoughts?

Lina Morales: They'll push back, CFO wants a line in contract. If legal won't add FedRAMP we should offer a letter of attestation from Security and a timeline for approval request. Could that work?

Anjali (Security): We can draft a letter: 1) attach latest SOC2; 2) provide completed security questionnaire; 3) commit to reviewing any documented gaps within 30 days. Not a FedRAMP claim but shows good faith.

Maya Chen: RevOps checklist: need amendment with new billing entity, separate invoice lines, payment terms, and POs in hand by 2024-05-20 to process for 6/1. Otherwise invoice will be delayed to next cycle.

Ravi (Finance): Also note: split invoices require separate billing contacts and GL codes. If Orchid wants seats invoiced to US and service to EU, request: PO_US, PO_EU, W9_US, VAT_EU, and contact emails.

Jared Kim: Pricing ask - they requested 6% loyalty discount for renewal if both entities sign a 2-year term. Can we do 6%?

Lina Morales: Approve up to 5% for 2-year. 6% requires director sign-off. Also require auto-renew opt-out language.

contract-bot: Draft amendment created: https://docsend.example/OrchidRenewalAmend_v4 (expires in 7 days). Included: split-billing table, security attachments, proposed 5% loyalty discount for 2-year term, net45 + 1.5% fee option.

Jared Kim: I'll send amendment + security letter to CFO and procurement. Ask them for PO_US and PO_EU and attach W-9/VAT docs. Request e-signature from authorized signatory; offer wet-sign as fallback.

Lina Morales: If they ask for FedRAMP language escalate to Legal (do not concede). Offer the security letter plus SOC2 and a 30-day remediation plan. Keep me posted.

Maya Chen: Flagging timeline risk: if we don't have POs by 2024-05-20, enablement and support allocation will be delayed. Recommend pushing internal renewal reminders to the CSM and AM.

Ravi (Finance): I'll prepare invoice templates for split billing and confirm GL codes once POs are received.

Jared Kim: Thanks team. Sending now. Will update thread when I hear back. :thumbsup:
